releases.new: Query data with NEAREST BY joins, plus new variant functions, JSON set/insert/replace/remove, nested schemas, AFTER triggers, async Parquet and CSV I/O, and external resources.
releases.breaking: Integer division by zero now raises an error instead of returning NULL; the ICU extension was removed, DECIMAL now promotes past BIGINT, and the C++ API changed, so test queries and extensions.

releases.new: Set the new enable_optimistic_write setting to control optimistic writes, backported from a later DuckDB version.
Use the duckdb:// URI scheme in the ADBC URI option, and query ADBC statistics through the new ADBC Statistics API support.
Set the experimental vacuum_rebuild_indexes option when attaching a database, and use new CLI dark-mode and light-mode options to control terminal background handling.
